name: President Securities Corporation
summary: President Securities Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in securities trading and margin lending, securities lending, futures business assistance, proprietary futures trading, issuing warrants, wealth management, and trust businesses. It operates through Brokerage Department, Measurement and Trading Department, Proprietary Trading Department, Financial Products Sector, Investment Companies, and Other Operating Departments segments.
